entry.title: dotnet/efcore - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-12-09
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Unify metadata for JSON column name and column name #37330
    Backlog
  • Should the absense of migration hisotry table it be logged as error? #37328
  • Bug in generated DATEDIFF call in SQL Server, first parameter is being replaced, leading to invalid SQL #37327

Closed

  • Contains fails to fallback to OPENJSON with many parameters in complex queries #37185
    10.0.2
  • EF Core 10 migrations do not convert ToJson() columns from nvarchar(max) to native json type when upgrading with UseCompatibilityLevel(170) #37275
    10.0.2
  • Unprefixed column changes ownership without moving old data when adding new type #37326
  • ParameterizedCollectionMode does not work on Mysql database. #37329
  • [dnceng-bot] Branch `efcore/release/9.0` can't be merged to Azdo internal branch #37318
  • EF Core 10 queries much slower than EF Core 9 with a larger number of parameters #37152
    10.0.2
  • EF Core applies string length conventions to ComplexCollection string properties #37256
    10.0.2
  • Conflict with RowVersion/Concurrency Token in TPH with Owned Entity as JSON (ValidateJsonProperties throws exception) #37274
    10.0.2
  • NullReferenceException in SqlServerAnnotationCodeGenerator when scaffolding columns with named default constraints and CLR default values #37175
    10.0.2
  • EF Core 10: Migration code for discriminators with default name is created each time I add a new migration #37143
    10.0.2

PullRequests

Created

  • Merge release/9.0 to release/9.0-staging #37331
  • [automated] Merge branch 'release/10.0' => 'main' #37324

Merged

  • [automated] Merge branch 'release/9.0' => 'release/10.0' #37309
  • Fix nullability when expading collection parameters. #37325
  • [release/10.0] Fix performance degradation for primitive collections for multiple parameters translation and deep trees with closure over same variable #37313
    Servicing-approved, 10.0.2
  • [automated] Merge branch 'release/10.0' => 'main' #37285
  • [release/10.0] Fallback to OPENJSON with many parameters #37320
    Servicing-approved, 10.0.2

Updated

  • [release/10.0] Fix nullable complex property with PropertyValues.ToObject() and SetValues() creating instance instead of null #37302
    Servicing-consider, 10.0.2
  • [release/10.0] Allow tools to run on projects targeting multiple frameworks #37301
    Servicing-consider, 10.0.2
  • Cosmos: Update pipeline complex properties #37322
  • Create table mappings for complex types in TPC #35314
  • Reverse processing order of setters in query generator #37323
